paragraphs.text:
The cord has d6+1 knots. You may
undo one knot to reroll one die at
any point of the game, as a free
action. However, every time to do
so, roll d6. If the total is lower than
the number of knots you have
undone so far, you lose 1 Sanity.
When the last knot is undone, you
roll for the last time and the cord
loses its powers.
